title: AphasiaBD: A Bengali Speech Dataset for Broca's and Global Aphasia
why_promising: Primary non-singing Bengali clinical production from 38 post-stroke patients. Zenodo reports 335 segmented clips across conversation, repetition, question-answering, and reading, with recordings manually segmented at sentence level. The public record names annotators and exposes a 194.3 MB Patient Data.zip with MD5 c2b0b71f5599d0c2a0f64bd03ed9dcb0. This is promising for clinical/group metadata, tasks, utterance-level manual segmentation, pauses/errors and any internal transcripts or metadata present in the archive.
open_question: Direct archive retrieval failed in this run, so internal filenames, participant mapping, transcription fields, clip durations, license terms, and any finer-grained annotations have not yet been verified. Keep in HIGH review until the ZIP can be enumerated and source-faithful tables built; do not infer phoneme labels or error categories from the landing-page description.
